# railway_access_group (Resource)

Railway access group. Members and projects are managed exclusively by Terraform: any member or project added outside of Terraform is removed on the next apply. Access groups are a beta Railway feature that is only available on eligible plans, see the [Railway docs](https://docs.railway.com/enterprise/access-groups).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_access_group" "example" {
  workspace_id = railway_project.example.workspace_id
  name         = "platform"
  role         = "MEMBER"
  member_ids   = ["89fa0236-2b1b-4a8c-b12d-ae3634b30d97"]
  project_ids  = [railway_project.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the access group.
- `role` (String) Role the access group grants on its projects. Possible values are `ADMIN`, `MEMBER` and `VIEWER`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the access group belongs to.

### Optional

- `member_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the users in the access group. They must be members of the workspace, see the `railway_workspace_members` data source. **Default** `[]`.
- `project_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the projects attached to the access group. **Default** `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the access group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import railway_access_group.example ecb63be7-63fb-47fe-95fc-1585d24e172d:227bc195-52fa-4d39-a872-a8cec0a0feca
```
